purpose: Strategic annotations for a growing subset of verified normalized actions. These values are judgements, not game facts, eligibility rules, or a generated route.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the quest is complete; it is a one-time early combat foundation, not a repeated training method.
candidates.reentry_condition: Do not re-enter; let the completed quest reward stand while the evaluator considers later unlocked actions.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the spirit-tree transport outcome is secured.
candidates.reentry_condition: Do not re-enter; revisit the Gnome Stronghold only when another eligible action makes it convenient.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the quest and gnome-glider transport outcome are complete.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter once 25 Agility is met and the action becomes eligible, especially when its transport supports nearby work.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after Varlamore and quetzal transport are unlocked.
candidates.reentry_condition: Do not re-enter; use the resulting access when Varlamore activities become eligible.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the quest is complete and the Ghostspeak amulet is secured.
candidates.reentry_condition: Do not re-enter; its quest flag and amulet feed later ghost and Morytania dependencies.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the quest, Morytania route, and Wolfbane are secured.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when one verified 50-essence preparation option is ready.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after completion, retaining the blessed sickle and druid pouch.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after both prerequisite quests and the silver-sickle preparation are complete.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after Zanaris access and at least one Dramen staff are secured.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter at 31 Crafting and 36 Woodcutting with the listed tools prepared.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after quest completion and Magic secateurs acquisition.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when Lost City, Nature Spirit, core tools, and the account-specific three-material assignment are ready.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after quest completion and its fixed rewards are secured.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when all three skill gates and the verified preparation inventory are ready.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop exactly at the permanent 100-Kudos Bone Voyage threshold unless another named reward justifies continuing.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after The Dig Site when a verified mix of Museum contributions can reach the remaining Kudos gap.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop once Fairy Godfather permission is recorded; actual ring use still requires a Dramen or Lunar staff unless the elite diary waives it.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when its prerequisite quest chain and staff preparation are complete; afterward use fairy rings to reduce travel across other eligible actions.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after claiming the separately confirmed current cloak tier; do not extend diary work solely to improve this transport option.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only when the diary claim is already confirmed and the cloak's current utility supports nearby work.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after buying the Chronicle only when its specific access is useful; cards remain a separately supplied consumable.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when the 300-coin purchase is already affordable and a distinct card-supported use is timely.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop at the player-chosen charged-necklace supply; never treat a replenishable teleport as a permanent unlock.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only when Magic and the exact jewellery and rune inputs are already available for a current travel need.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop at the player-chosen charged-ring supply; never treat a replenishable teleport as a permanent unlock.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only when Magic and the exact jewellery and rune inputs are already available for a current travel need.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after Fossil Island access is unlocked; establish its individual loops separately when ready.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when The Dig Site and 100 kudos make the action eligible, particularly before pursuing birdhouse or seaweed setups.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the loop is established; do not turn the setup itself into a long session.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter as a short recurring passive task when Fossil Island access, 25 Construction, and a suitable attention window are available.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the seaweed setup is established; harvests belong in the passive lane.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter as a short recurring passive task when Fossil Island, 23 Farming, and a seaweed spore are available.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the immediate reward, Firemaking, or supply objective has been met, or when repetition outweighs its current value.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter for a defined near-term objective at 50 Firemaking or above; avoid treating it as a mandatory default grind.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the current Fishing, food, or reward objective is met rather than committing to an open-ended session.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter at 35 Fishing or above when its rewards serve a concrete account need or offer a desired content change.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the immediate Hunter or reward goal, and switch if the current rumour loop stops being enjoyable or useful.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after Varlamore access and 46 Hunter when a varied active task fits the account's next objective.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the identified GP commitment is funded or the short cash objective is reached.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter at 30 Agility only when it is a named way to meet a specific cash deadline, with travel and desert supplies prepared separately.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop once the permanent enchantment knowledge is recorded; making or spending individual pendants is a separate decision.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after The Dig Site with a clean necklace when Digsite or Fossil Island transport will support nearby objectives.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop once the permanent Fossil Island destination is bound.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after Bone Voyage with a charged pendant, especially before recurring Fossil Island work.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the route is unlocked and let later travel demand justify individual trips.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when the balloon network, 60 Firemaking, and the three Magic logs are already available.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the management loop and Miscellania transport are unlocked; resource collection remains a separately observed passive decision.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when its quest gates and one verified kingdom-work preparation path are naturally ready.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the player-confirmed collection and updated Kingdom observation; do not infer resources or elapsed production.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only when the established Kingdom loop is player-marked ready and a short present-attention window is available.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the player-confirmed session; its experience result and next readiness remain observations rather than inferred outputs.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only when the established loop is player-marked ready and the account can give it a brief active session.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the immediate Runecraft, rune, pearl, or variety objective is met instead of treating reward rolls as a mandatory grind.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after Temple of the Eye at 27 Runecraft with a pickaxe when its mixed outputs serve a current need.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the current Farming or points objective is met; it should not displace better-aligned farming work by default.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter at 34 Farming with the required planting and watering tools when a specific Tithe reward is useful.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the chosen Smithing, coins, reputation, or reward target is met, or when the commission loop no longer fits the account's metal supply.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after Sleeping Giants when available metal inputs and a bucket or ice gloves support a defined output need.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop immediately after buying the rune pouch; the arena is not scored as an open-ended activity.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only after all four verified pizazz balances are already held and the pouch's inventory utility matters now.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after Sailing access and its fixed entry rewards are secured; assess its separate activities against current goals.
candidates.reentry_condition: Do not re-enter; complete it when the account is ready to make Sailing available as an option.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop once the Skiff is purchased; do not treat the 15,000-coin cost as a universal early deadline.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after Pandemonium at 15 Sailing only when the Skiff enables a desired Sailing activity or access goal.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the current bounty objective or desired activity change is met; assigned rewards remain variable.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after Pandemonium at 30 Sailing when a bounty's variable outputs suit a current economic or variety need.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the current Sailing, salvage, or variety objective is met; no assumed loot target justifies open-ended repetition.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after Pandemonium at 15 Sailing with a salvaging hook and a capable boat when its variable outputs fit a current need.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the quest, fixed skill XP, broad Kourend access, and Book of the Dead utility are secured; do not extend the detour merely to keep questing.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when the prerequisite quest and skill state, memoir pages, preparation items, and observed combat readiness make its combined XP and access value timely.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop once house ownership is recorded; treat rooms, restoration, prayer, and transport upgrades as separate demand-driven decisions.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when the ownership cost or Daddy's Home path is ready and a named first POH utility will immediately support account activity.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the Superior Garden is built; advance the POH pool only when repeated recovery demand and the next material budget justify it.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when the Construction gate, coins, and the next restoration or transport use are observed, rather than pursuing the garden as a blanket construction target.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the ornate pool is built; its value comes from repeated PvM and travel recovery, not from reaching a Construction milestone for its own sake.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only when the prior pool, Construction level, materials, and observed repeated recovery demand make this expensive stage pay back.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the crystalline nexus upgrade when its selected destinations cover real travel demand; do not buy destinations or tiers without a use case.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when the prior nexus state, Construction and material requirements, and observed destination demand show a clear travel payback over available alternatives.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after claiming the current Explorer's ring tier; value the material run-energy and teleport utility rather than diary completion as an achievement.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when the player has confirmed a new eligible tier and its material utility serves current travel or skilling demand.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop immediately after buying the coal bag; Motherlode is a means to the storage utility, not a reason to pursue 99 Mining.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when the golden-nugget balance is ready and coal capacity will improve a named Smithing, furnace, or Giants' Foundry pipeline.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop immediately after buying the gem bag; do not continue Motherlode solely for another storage purchase without a current gem or Crafting need.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when the golden-nugget balance is ready and gem storage will materially improve observed mining, gem collection, or Crafting work.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after buying the Seed box; do not continue Tithe Farm without another named reward or Farming objective.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when 250 observed Tithe Farm points are ready and six-type seed storage serves a current loot or Farming loop.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after buying the Herb sack; do not continue Tithe Farm solely because more shop rewards exist.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when 58 Herblore, 250 observed Tithe Farm points, and a current grimy-herb inventory need are all present.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after buying the Herb sack; preserve remaining Slayer points for separately evaluated unlocks.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when 58 Herblore, 750 observed Slayer points, and a current grimy-herb inventory need justify this alternative.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after buying the Rune pouch; preserve remaining Slayer points for separately evaluated unlocks.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when 750 observed Slayer points are ready and rune-slot compression has an immediate combat, spellbook, skilling, or transport use.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the quest and its fixed access and XP are secured; treat Moons farming as a separate readiness and reward decision.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when the skill and quest gates, supplies, and observed combat readiness make its self-contained encounter preparation worthwhile now.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the current utility, gear, or supply objective is met; do not turn self-contained supplies and variable Lunar Chest rewards into an open-ended grind.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only with observed combat readiness, a recovery and death plan, and a named reward or gear need that justifies the encounter risk now.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop at the current food, Fishing, or short low-attention objective, or when the selected spot moves or inventory capacity requires a handling choice; do not extend it into an assumed catch-rate grind.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter during a player-present low-attention window when a qualifying selected spot and small net are available and the account has a real catch or Fishing need.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop at the current food, Fishing, or short low-attention objective, or when the spot moves, feathers run out, or inventory capacity requires a handling choice; no catch mix or XP rate is assumed.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter during a player-present low-attention window when Fishing 20, a fly rod, feathers, and a qualifying selected lure spot are all currently available.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop at the current food, Cooking, or player-chosen karambwan objective, or when bait or carrying capacity is exhausted; static spots do not justify an open-ended activity assumption.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter for a player-present low-attention window only after Fishing 65, the partial Tai Bwo Wannai Trio access, a vessel, raw karambwanji, and a chosen safe access method are confirmed; fish barrel and travel upgrades remain optional.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop at the current log, Firemaking, Fletching, or short Woodcutting objective, or when the tree depletes or inventory needs handling; willow cutting is never presented as unattended AFK.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter during a player-present low-attention window when Woodcutting 30, a usable axe, and an accessible selected willow are confirmed.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop at the current log, banked-supply, or Woodcutting objective, or when the selected tree depletes or inventory needs handling; no nest, Forestry, XP, or log total is assumed.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter during a player-present low-attention window when Woodcutting 60, a usable axe, and an accessible selected yew are confirmed.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop at the current log, Woodcutting, or low-attention objective, or when the selected section depletes or inventory needs handling; this is not a 99 recommendation or an unattended-safety claim.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter during a player-present low-attention window when visible Woodcutting 90, a usable axe, observed Woodcutting Guild access, and an available redwood section are confirmed.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop at the selected utility target, such as coal bag, gem bag, or a named Prospector milestone; do not recommend 99 Mining for efficiency alone.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when a current storage, Smithing, Mining, or AFK objective justifies the attention cost and the next selected utility has a defined stop point.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the current player-chosen Mining or low-attention window ends, or when the observed star is no longer available or acceptable; do not turn an observed star into a stardust, gem, or 99 target.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only while player-present when Mining 10, a usable pickaxe, and a fresh available and acceptable selected-star observation are all recorded.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop at the player-selected learning, reward, page, or collection boundary; do not turn targetable loot into an assumed drop or grind length.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only with a current player-selected objective and observed access, recovery, tactical, and optional duo plan.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop at the player-selected learning, rune, equipment, diary, or collection boundary; chest contents remain variable.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only with a current player-selected objective and observed travel, tactical, supply, and recovery plan.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop at the player-selected learning, attention, risk, resource, equipment, or collection boundary; no seed or completion target is assumed.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only after formal unlock confirmation, a current high-attention window, and an observed player-selected objective.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the current combat or low-attention window ends, or when the selected method, safety, or readiness observation changes; no kill, drop, XP, or 99 target is assumed.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only while player-present with fresh available and acceptable selected-method observations and a current combat readiness observation; location access and survival remain player-confirmed rather than inferred.
